pages.title: Nutrx — Stop Guessing. Start Knowing.
pages.description: Tell verified health supplements from fake and recalled ones. Compare products, check FDA recalls and hidden ingredients, and learn with the NUTRX Series.

team.title: About Us & Our Team · Nutrx
team.description: Why we built Nutrx: one trustworthy place to see which health products are verified, which are fake or recalled, and what fits you. Meet founder Joan Kim.

verified-products.title: Verified Health Products · Nutrx
verified-products.description: Browse health supplements with documented ingredients, functions and cautions — plus what is still unknown — so you can choose with evidence, not marketing.

fake-products.title: Fake & Recalled Health Products · Nutrx
fake-products.description: Search recalled, tainted and deceptively marketed supplements: what they claimed, what went wrong — hidden drugs, contamination, false claims — and the outcome.

suggestions.title: Compare Health Products · Nutrx
suggestions.description: Compare up to four health supplements side by side — claims, cautions, recall history and sources — and save your favorites.

submit-product.title: Submit a Product for Review · Nutrx
submit-product.description: Seen a health product with claims that seem too good to be true? Send it to Nutrx and we will check it against FDA, FTC and NIH records.

series.title: NUTRX Series · Nutrx
series.description: Short one-page articles on nutrition and health: Inside the Ingredient explains common nutrients, and Health Fraud Files looks at real health scams.

series/inside-the-ingredient.title: Inside the Ingredient · NUTRX Series
series/inside-the-ingredient.description: A guide to the nutrients behind common health foods: what each one does, where to find it, and whether you really need a supplement.

series/health-fraud-files.title: Health Fraud Files · NUTRX Series
series/health-fraud-files.description: Real-world cases of health fraud and the people behind them — and the patterns that make health deception so convincing.

contact.title: Contact Us · Nutrx
contact.description: Questions, a product to report, or want to join the team? Send Nutrx a quick message.
